control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: near hit during cleaning and preparation on TX-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on TX-9001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-9001 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 24 October 2005 a near hit was recorded on TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
